keys.description:
Easiest: open **NOIR Builder** (sidebar) → tab *Remote* → *First-time setup*, fill in your Wi-Fi and press **Download secrets.yaml**. Put it in the `firmware` folder.

Or save this text yourself as **secrets.yaml** in the `firmware` folder and fill in your Wi-Fi.

```
{block}
```

You can see it again later in the NOIR Builder (tab Remote).
